sam: Heads-up — running into a weird mypy/pyright failure from the Python SDK's autogenerated models.

sam: When the OpenAPI generator emits response types it sometimes uses `Union[str, List[str]]` for fields that are effectively always a list. mypy then complains when we do list comprehensions.

sam: Example: 
```py
# generated
class Choice(BaseModel):
    text: Union[str, List[str]]

# usage
out = [c.text.strip() for c in response.choices]  # mypy: Item "str" of "Union[str, List[str]]" has no attribute "strip"
```

elaine: Ugh. That Union typing comes from ambiguous schema examples in the model manifest. We should nudge the generator to prefer the more specific schema (array) when examples show arrays. :grimacing:

mike: Workaround for now: `from typing import cast` and `texts = [cast(str, c.text).strip() for c in response.choices]` — ugly but buys time. Or `if isinstance(c.text, list): ...` but yeah messy.

ivy: Also seeing `Optional[dict]` or raw `Any` for `metadata` fields which kills IDE completions. MyPy flags `Any` as well in strict mode.

sam: Another related: async client stub missing `overload` signatures, so `await client.chat.create(...)` returns `Any` in our projects. Pyright warns with `reportGeneralTypeIssues`.

elaine: Can we land two small fixes: 1) generator tweak to prefer array type when examples are arrays, 2) annotate async client's coroutine return type properly (Generic[ResponseT])?

mike: I can sketch a generator patch. Plan: when scanning `oneOf/anyOf` prefer the branch that matches example types or is array/object over plain string. Also emit `List[str]` instead of `Union[str,List[str]]` if examples present.

sam: That would solve 70% of our team's complaints. Also propose adding a small `typing_stubs.py` that maps some of the worst offenders to concrete types for now.

ivy: For the async issue: client methods currently typed like `def create(...)-> Coroutine[Any, Any, Any]`. If we change to `def create(...) -> Coroutine[Any, Any, CreateResponse]` or better `async def create(...) -> CreateResponse` in stubs, IDEs will pick it up.

devex-bot: Issue created: https://redwood.internal/issue/SDK-typing-2387 (auto). Tags: devex, python, mypy, generator.

elaine: Nice — can someone open a PR adding a tiny mypy/pyright smoke check to CI that runs a sample app with `--strict`? We can catch regressions early.

mike: I'll do the generator patch + tests. Sam, can you add a reproducible minimum failing example (repo or gist) so CI can consume it?

sam: Yeah will push a minimal repro to `gitlab.com/rw-sdk/typing-repro` today.

ivy: Also adding a doc note in the SDK troubleshooting page about using `typing.cast` as a short-term workaround could save folks headache.

elaine: OK — owners: mike (generator fix), sam (repro + typing_stubs), ivy (docs), devex (CI check). Target: end of sprint.

sam: Thanks all. If anyone hits more odd unions or `Any` spots, drop them in the issue thread. :thumbsup:

mike: will link PR here when ready.
